data.Details: Synthetic relational test dataset designed to exercise the existing v4.0 Skills plus the proposed Growth Intelligence extensions.
Synthetic; no real customer or personal data.
Upload this workbook to Claude with the plugin/Skills enabled. Start with Test_Cases or ask Claude to run all tests and populate Test_Results.
Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Pipeline Snapshots, Activities, Service Cases, Finance, Product Usage, Marketing, Contracts, Competitors, Whitespace.
16 Skills are represented in Test_Cases T01-T16.
T17-T22 exercise Growth Signal Orchestrator, Growth Opportunity Discovery, Account Economics, Competitive Intelligence, Business Intelligence Copilot, Continuous Business Watch.
Expected outputs are intentionally explicit so you can compare Claude's actual output against known signals.
Run T01-T22 individually first, then ask Claude for an end-to-end Growth Command Center analysis across the entire workbook.
Added Pricing Intelligence, Price Optimization, Price Elasticity, Competitive Pricing, Margin Optimization, Discount Governance, Pricing Leakage, Portfolio Pricing and Scenario Pricing.
P01-P10 in Pricing_Test_Cases exercise the pricing capability across deal, portfolio and executive use cases.
